command: set -euo pipefail; for i in $(seq 1 10); do pnpm --filter @riccon/web exec vitest run src/pages/chat/knowledge-and-sharing.test.tsx > /tmp/m24-ks-$i.log 2>&1; grep -E "Tests  [0-9]+ passed" /tmp/m24-ks-$i.log; done; pnpm -w typecheck; pnpm --filter @riccon/web run lint; echo ks-10x-ok
note: 同类异步竞态：先等销售部再断言；单文件 10 次+typecheck+lint
